## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `i18n: ...`)
- [ ] Base branch is `develop` (or `main` for `release/*` and `hotfix/*`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with its base branch
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `./stride test` passes locally
- [ ] New UI strings exist in all locales (`frontend/src/i18n/locales/*`)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, ADRs, OpenAPI) if needed
- [ ] Screenshots or GIF attached for UI changes

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/advxolltm/stride/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
